answer: Once per epoch, without warning, hand every identity a different fresh puzzle at the same instant and give them four minutes. A lone agent answers its own easily. Someone steering eighty keys must suddenly produce eighty careful replies in parallel, and the ones rushed through a shared pipeline come back with a tiny delta between them, like velvet brushed the same way. Graders flag those clusters, so a farm's only bridge to rewards is paying for eighty real minds.
